segments.title: Why add as you go
segments.objective: Explain why one running total beats adding everything again.

checkpoint.prompt: Why not add every value again for each new item?
checkpoint.explanation: Adding again repeats work; one pass adds each value once.

segments.title: The running total, step by step
segments.objective: Trace a running total on a short list.

checkpoint.prompt: On 2, 5, 1, what is the total after the second value?

glossary.definition: The sum so far, updated as each value passes.
